description: Generates a 3-month SEO performance HTML report for any domain using DataForSEO data. Use this skill whenever a user provides a target domain and a list of competitor URLs and asks for an SEO report, performance report, SEO analysis, competitive SEO comparison, traffic report, ranking report, or 3-month SEO summary. Always use this skill for SEO report generation — do not attempt to build the report without following this structured data-fetch and HTML generation workflow.
